_provenance.upstream_operation: SHA-2 (1.0) and SHA-3 (2.0) AFT digest cases and standard Monte Carlo (MCT) groups — one upstream file per digest; each testGroup names its own upstream file
_provenance.local_operation: AFT: C_DigestInit(CKM_<hash>) + C_Digest(msg), output byte-compared to md. MCT (standard): the ACVP chained-digest loop (SHA-2: MSG = MD[i-3]||MD[i-2]||MD[i-1]; SHA-3: MSG = MD[i-1]) run for 1000 C_Digest calls from the seed, the result byte-compared to the first of the 100 upstream outer-iteration outputs
_provenance.transformation: subset only; every retained field is byte-copied from the upstream files (hex case preserved); MCT resultsArray truncated to its first element
_provenance.subset_policy: Deterministic. Per digest (the 10 SHA-2/SHA-3 digests both engines advertise), byte-aligned AFT cases only (PKCS#11 digests whole bytes), excluding any case whose md is already carried by sha256/sha384/sha512/sha3_256/sha3_512_test: the empty message, the shortest non-empty message, the messages of exactly block-1, block and block+1 bytes, and for SHA-2 the 55/56-byte (64-byte block) or 119/120-byte (128-byte block) length-field boundary, where the upstream sample has them; plus the longest message; ties by lowest tcId. The SHA2-256, SHA2-512 and SHA2-512/256 samples carry no message shorter than 215 bytes, so they have no empty/short/block-boundary case here. Standard-version MCT groups (SHA2-224/384/512-224, all SHA-3): the single upstream case with its first outer-iteration result only (1000 chained digests). Alternate-version MCT groups (SHA2-256/512/512-256) and every LDT group (a 1 GiB expanded message) are listed in notExecuted.
_provenance.retained_fields: tcId, msg, len, md (AFT); tcId, msg, len, resultsArray[0] (MCT)
